hotel_name: Hotel White Saffron By F9 Hotels

positive_snippets:
Budget friendly hotel with decent rooms. Easily approachable from Pitampura and Kohat metro stations.

Front-end girl is very warm, helpful and accommodative. She knows her job very well.

Recommend this hotel for people, who don't want a hole in their pocket.
The stay was good. Clean room and parking space easiness
negative_snippets:
Don’t go there. Everything from rooms condition to service are bad. Not even proper toiletries are provided.
Not recommended at all.

Giving it one star because couldn’t go below it.
It was a horrible experience.
Room has a weird smell, fan and ac aren’t working properly, tripped after every two minutes the whole night.

Dirty rooms, its a oyo and you can feel it there.
They have a restaurant which has a long menu but taste is not upto the mark. High price for a cheap and dirty room, not acceptable.
